comment_templates.triaged_to_roadmap:
Thank you for reporting this. Triaged and queued for a fix.

For transparency: fixes here are produced by an automated pipeline and verified against an automated test suite (6,400+ tests), and we run mRemoteNG daily on the latest build ourselves. What we cannot do is reproduce *your* setup -- your network, servers, locale, the exact state that triggers this. That is the honest limit of our testing, and it is why your feedback here is what actually verifies a fix.

comment_templates.iteration_ack:
Noted -- the issue is not fully resolved. Thank you for retesting.

Per our process: after two fix attempts on an unproven premise, the next build ships instrumentation to capture trace data instead of another guess, and after three failed rounds the issue is flagged for human review. You will not be asked to test blind fixes indefinitely.
comment_templates.followup_7d: Checking in: the fix for this issue has been in the nightly for a week. If you have had a chance to test, a quick yes/no here closes the loop -- and if it still fails, say so and it gets escalated. If we do not hear back, the issue simply stays open; no pressure.
